beats.text: In South Sudan, 14.5 percent of primary teachers are women. In Belarus, it's 99.5 percent.
South Sudan is the world's lowest, counting both full-time and part-time staff.
India has 58.6 percent, while the USA has 87.5 percent.
Stepping up the list, Moldova has 98.3 percent, Ukraine 98.6 percent, Kyrgyzstan 98.9 percent, and Russia 99.3 percent.
Belarus is the world's highest, where women account for 99.5 percent of primary teachers.
What was the gender balance among your primary school teachers?
